import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text
from datetime import datetime

# Define the timestamp
timestamp = '2025-10-05 18:00:00'

# Query to find all severely congested road segments at the specified time
query_severe_congestion = text(f"""
SELECT rs.id AS road_segment_id, rs.geometry
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrt
JOIN road_segment rs ON hrt.road_segment_id = rs.id
WHERE hrt.datetime = '{timestamp}'
AND hrt.congestion_status = 3
""")

severe_congestion_segments = pd.read_sql(query_severe_congestion, engine)

# Find the nearest air quality station to any of these segments
if not severe_congestion_segments.empty:
    query_nearest_station = text(f"""
    SELECT aqs.id, aqs.name_en, aqs.coordinate, ST_Distance(
        aqs.coordinate::geography,
        (SELECT geometry::geography FROM road_segment WHERE id = {severe_congestion_segments['road_segment_id'].iloc[0]})
    ) AS distance
    FROM air_quality_station aqs
    ORDER BY distance
    LIMIT 1
    """)

    nearest_station = pd.read_sql(query_nearest_station, engine)
    severe_congestion_station_id = nearest_station['id'].iloc[0]

    # Query the NO2 concentration at the nearest station at the specified time
    query_no2_concentration = text(f"""
    SELECT no2
    FROM hourly_station_air_quality
    WHERE station_id = {severe_congestion_station_id}
    AND datetime = '{timestamp}'
    """)

    no2_concentration = pd.read_sql(query_no2_concentration, engine)
    severe_congestion_station_no2 = no2_concentration['no2'].iloc[0]

    print(f"Nearest station ID: {severe_congestion_station_id}")
    print(f"NO2 concentration at the nearest station: {severe_congestion_station_no2} μg/m³")
else:
    print("No severely congested road segments found at the specified time.")
